changelog:
v4.2.1 — Series Playback & Connection Fixes

• Fixed series episodes that failed to play and showed "server is having issues": the app no longer retries a series with the wrong file type, and shows an accurate message instead.
• When your account hits its simultaneous-connection limit, you'll now see a clear "close Ooustream on your other devices and try again" message instead of a generic server error.
• Reduced cases where the app briefly opened a second stream on its own — when retrying a series, choosing "Watch Next", or auto-playing the next episode — which could trip your account's connection limit.

Applies to all devices.
